newsitem.title: USA: Costa Rica Intl may have overstated assets.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica Intl may have overstated assets.

text.p: Costa Rica International Inc said Wednesday it would amend certain reports it filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission as it may have overstated its assets by between $20 million and $25 million.
Any overstatement was a result of errors in accounting for its acquisition of 60 percent of the capital stock of Corporacion Pipasa in August, the company said.
The company said it would release revised financial data as soon as it became available.

Management believed the revised financial statements would not have a material effect on the company's revenues or earnings for its fiscal year ended September 30, 1996 or the most recent fiscal quarter ended December 31, 1996, it said.
Costa Rica International was not immediately available to comment further.
